parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH to 6. val_bpb dropped to 1.019192. Increasing model capacity seems to yield high returns within the 5-minute budget. Moving to round 3 to refine depth and explore learning rate/warmup with this larger architecture.
